{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Check their status
print("QA orders status:", qa_orders['status'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Count completed orders, excluding QA orders
completed_without_qa = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue'] != '999999.99')].shape[0]
print("Completed orders excluding QA:", completed_without_qa)

# Total completed orders (including QA)
total_completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]
print("Total completed orders (including QA):", total_completed)"}
